```{r read data}

lizard <- read.csv( "lizard.csv", fileEncoding = "latin1")

str(lizard)
```

```{r data summary}

summary_table <- map_dfr(names(lizard), function(v) {

  x <- lizard[[v]]

  if (is.numeric(x)) {

    tibble(
      Variable = v,
      Type = "Numeric",
      Min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      Max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      Categories = NA_character_
    )

  } else if (is.factor(x) || is.character(x)) {

    tibble(
      Variable = v,
      Type = "Categorical",
      Min = NA_real_,
      Max = NA_real_,
      Mean = NA_real_,
      Categories = paste(unique(na.omit(x)), collapse = ", ")
    )

  } else {
    NULL
  }
})

View(summary_table)

```


```{r}
cor_matrix <- lizard %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  cor()
corrplot(cor_matrix)
```

```{r}

split_lizard <- initial_split(lizard_climate, prop = 0.75, strata = "Mean.Clutch.Size")
train_lizard <- analysis(split_lizard)
test_lizard  <- assessment(split_lizard)

maximal_tree <- rpart(
  Mean.Clutch.Size ~ . ,
  data = train_lizard,
  method = "class",
  control = rpart.control(minsplit = 2, cp = 0.018, xval = 10)
)

rpart.plot(maximal_tree)
```
